title: Breastfed babies need extra vitamin D from birth, CDC says
summary: CDC says breast milk is excellent nutrition, and that breastfed infants still need extra vitamin D starting at birth, and possibly iron.
body: On the breastfeeding page updated 31 July 2026, CDC says breast milk is an excellent source of nutrition. The same section says breastfed infants will need extra vitamin D beginning at birth, and possibly iron supplements. The page does not print a dose in the sentences used here. It points readers onward for more on vitamins and minerals. This is United States CDC guidance, not a prescription for one infant.

sources.title: Breastfeeding Fast Facts
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US CDC page. Public domain. Paraphrased. Supports the vitamin D and possible iron sentence.
